name: PunisherWatchlist
description: Adds eye buttons to movies, series, and episodes plus a personal Watchlist tab on the Jellyfin home screen.

versions.changelog: Moves Watchlist to its own standalone Jellyfin list route instead of opening the native Favorites tab internally. The page remains fully native through Jellyfin's list, card, hover-menu, sorting, paging, metadata, and responsive components while Favorites and Watchlist are now completely independent.
